decision: Keep a private predicate passthrough route for each page before removing any temporary route; migrate all 44 unroute calls and prevent direct calls with ESLint
why: Continuous Chromium reads strand when interception is disabled; waiting for handlers alone also strands reads; a predicate fallback preserves temporary route precedence and cannot be removed by a string or RegExp pattern
result: Measured 22 stranded reads for native removal, 24 for unrouteAll(wait), zero with persistent fallback on Chromium 139 / Playwright 1.54.2; regression and affected journeys to verify integration
